objective: Test whether native event-time aggression episodes contain a repeatable after-cost continuation or absorption-reversal markout large enough to justify broader reconstruction before any official 2024 opening.

used_pre_cutoff_sources.role: time-and-sales sequencing and pace as observable market state
aggressive versus passive participation and order-flow interpretation
absorption as aggressive effort that fails to produce directional price result

used_pre_cutoff_sources.title: 5D ORDER FLOW
used_pre_cutoff_sources.role: tape speed plus bid/offer control; effort-versus-result distinction

translation_to_testable_variables.pace: episode total aggressor notional divided by causal episode duration
translation_to_testable_variables.control: absolute signed aggressor-notional imbalance divided by total notional
translation_to_testable_variables.effort_result_efficiency: direction-adjusted displacement divided by log(1 + episode notional)
translation_to_testable_variables.absorption: high effort and control with low efficiency plus end-of-episode retracement
translation_to_testable_variables.initiation: high effort and control with high positive displacement efficiency

data_contract.market: USDT linear perpetual public historical trades
data_contract.integrity: downloaded gzip bytes, line count, CRC read and SHA-256 are recorded

causal_event_contract.episode_closure: an episode is available only after the quiet interval has elapsed or the preregistered duration cap is reached
causal_event_contract.entry_mark: first observed trade at or after decision time plus latency
causal_event_contract.one_global_slot: enforced independently for each candidate and markout horizon across BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT
causal_event_contract.same_timestamp_tie_break: stable symbol ordering from the deterministic event sort

hypotheses.logic: high notional, high pace, high control, high positive impact efficiency and limited retracement indicate initiative flow whose price response persists
high notional, high pace and control but low impact efficiency with material retracement indicate aggression absorbed by passive liquidity

frozen_candidate_grid.threshold_learning: symbol-and-segmentation quantiles are estimated only from the three fit dates

cost_and_execution_screen.funding: not material over 10-300 second markout windows and therefore not separately modeled at this fatal-screen stage
cost_and_execution_screen.qualification: fatal alpha screen only; a survivor must receive exact BBO/depth, structural exits, risk sizing, funding and NAV replay before becoming rank eligible

conditional_next_stage.if_zero_survivors: report reusable negative evidence, keep 2024-2026 sealed and move to a structurally different source/payoff
conditional_next_stage.if_one_or_more_survivors: expand reconstruction across 2023 before freezing one family for sequential 2024 evaluation; do not tune on 2024

prohibitions: no 2024, 2025 or 2026 download in this workflow
no promotion into the cumulative strategy ranking from this sparse screen
